name: The Biology Lab Mystery
tip: Remember: producers make their own food, while consumers obtain energy by eating.

questions.q: Which part of a plant mainly absorbs water from the soil?
questions.why: Root hairs absorb water and mineral ions from the soil.

questions.q: What is the main function of red blood cells?
questions.why: Haemoglobin in red blood cells carries oxygen around the body.

questions.q: Which organisms break down dead material?
questions.why: Fungi and bacteria are important decomposers in ecosystems.
